analysis_options.api: Direct ActionNameVars::perform/apply invocation over a synthetic per-case Funcdata body; no ActionGroup or other Action runs
analysis_options.funcdata: Locked BfdArchitecture over the pinned Git-blob curl input supplies Ghidra Funcdata, address spaces, TypeFactory, and the ScopeLocal. Each Ghidra case clears prior state via fd.clear(); Rugra builds an isolated synthetic Funcdata per case with an ActionRestructureVarnode-built ScopeLocal.
analysis_options.ir: Register leaves are SSA inputs; outputs are written register-space Varnodes defined by COPY(const) ops at explicit code addresses, each with a unique-space reader COPY. HighVariables are assigned by setHighLevel before the Action runs.
analysis_options.normalization: No Ghidra/Rugra behavior difference is normalized or removed. Pointer/Arc addresses and dynamic-symbol hashes are internal identities (map keys) and never appear in the records; the dynamic-path observable is the dyn flag plus the finished name. Metatype numbers use the Ghidra type.hh:79-99 enum values on both sides.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; ActionNameVars and fixture construction are deterministic

cases.shape: four written register-space temporaries (bool@0x48, char@0x50, int4@0x58, char*@0x60) each defined by COPY(const) at 0x1000..0x1030 with a unique-space reader COPY at pc+0x10
cases.expected: linkSymbol creates ScopeLocal Symbols carrying each HighVariable type; ActionNameVars::apply names them bVar5/cVar6/iVar7/pcVar8 through the shared base counter after the four unique-space reader symbols (Var1-4); varnodes marked mapped

cases.shape: one register-space input at offset 0x08 size 8 (RCX) typed int
cases.expected: linkSymbol creates the local Symbol with usepoint = function base - 1 (varnode.cc:696-703); buildDefaultName's vn path drives the irregular-input branch, naming it in_RCX via the translate register table

cases.shape: 4-byte register temporary at 0x70 defined by COPY(const) at the function base - 1 with a unique-space reader, plus a 1-byte register INPUT at 0x71 typed char
cases.expected: the input's linkSymbol finds the 4-byte Symbol via queryProperties (usepoints match at base-1); handleSymbolConflict's isInput leg attaches the partial entry; HighVariable::setSymbol computes symboloffset=1 (variable.cc:258-270 branch 4), so the input high fails coreaction.cc:2965's getSymbolOffset() < 0 namerec gate and shares the whole symbol's name

observation_schema.format: Six fixed-order UTF-8 records (before/after for three cases) with a final newline
observation_schema.identity: Pointer/Arc addresses are map keys only. Fixture varnodes and highs use semantic names. Dynamic-symbol hashes are internal identities and never appear; the dynamic storage observable is the dyn flag.
observation_schema.fields: Per high: semantic name, attached Symbol projection (name, Ghidra-enum metatype, size, printNameBase prefix, category, storage space, offset, entry size, dynamic flag, first usepoint or invalid) and symbolOffset; per varnode: mapped/input/persist flags.
observation_schema.raw_difference_policy: The runner pins both complete output streams via the comparand block; every record must be byte-identical (no masking classes).

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-linksymbol-typed-base-overlay-v1 plus base commit and sorted length-prefixed paths and contents
comparand.rust_crate_source_policy: Every crate file comes from the pinned base commit 895f69d0baebeb67db7ae27cc1ba676b8fcb4f5d Git blob except the src/{funcdata,coreaction,varmap,merge}.rs overlays, which are taken from the live working tree

overall_status: UNTESTED: (B2 downgrade: two-sided pinning incomplete - (B2 canonicalization)...
overall_status_rationale: All four records are byte-identical against the locked 12.0.4 oracle: linkSymbol's typed register-temporary Symbol creation (bVar/cVar/iVar/pcVar family through the shared base counter), the irregular-input naming (in_RCX), mapped-flag propagation, and usepoint computation (def-op address; function base - 1 for inputs). The handleSymbolConflict -> buildDynamicSymbol conflict path is implemented but UNTESTED at oracle level: the locked oracle's DynamicHash::uniqueHash throws RecovError ('Unable to find unique hash for varnode') for every minimal same-address two-High shape attempted, aborting ActionNameVars before an after-record exists. Rugra mirrors the failure (returns None and keeps the pre-existing entry attached) instead of aborting the Action. A dedicated fixture with hash-unique conflicting dataflow is registered as the follow-up.
